question.question: What dish does Dave recommend Calvin to try in Tokyo?

evidence_items.text:
- The 2023-05-03 conversation ended with Calvin thanking Dave for the creativity advice ("taking a break is great for getting my mojo back"), saying he won't give up, and "let's stay in touch"; Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing his music and said Calvin can reach out anytime if he needs help [S5T12][S5T13][S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Dave ("long time no chat") and told him the flood had been tough but that he's staying positive; shared his studio photo, asked Dave what exciting projects he's working on, and Dave excitedly told him about the shop's celebration — the two wished each other well (Calvin: "Can't wait to get back to making music") [S6T1][S6T3][S6T5][S6T6][S6T7][S6T8].
- The 2023-05-16 exchange continued: Calvin congratulated Dave on opening his own car shop ("Way to go, Dave!" / "Keep up the great work!"); Dave thanked him, and when Dave asked if anything exciting was happening in the world of music, Calvin shared the upcoming Tokyo performance (see ## Tokyo trip, ## Music) [S6T9][S6T10][S6T11]; Dave wished him luck, and Calvin promised to keep him posted on how it goes [S6T12][S6T13]; Calvin then shared the Tokyo night-skyline photo (details in ## Tokyo trip) [S6T13][S6T15].
- On 2023-05-31, reconnected with Dave ("been ages since we chatted") and told him the Frank Ocean tour the week before was "wild", including the "unreal" Tokyo show (details in ## Tokyo trip); Dave congratulated him [S7T1][S7T2]. Calvin thought Dave's car photo was of the car Dave had been fixing the engine of for a friend (Dave's neighbor; details in /memories/dave.md, section "Car maintenance shop"). The two also talked about how working on cars is relaxing: for Calvin it "chill[s]" him, "clears [his] head", "calms [him] down", and gives a real sense of achievement — "like meditating" — and Dave said the same applies to him (details in /memories/dave.md, section "Hobbies and sense of purpose") [S7T3][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6].
- The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed Dave's "feeling of power and happiness" from the transformation talk — "It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas" [S7T9]. Dave asked whether he always enjoys performing live (see ## Music), then what's next for his music; Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour — "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (see the Boston trip section above) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T14][S7T15]. Dave said he'll be at the Boston show to cheer him on [S7T16]. The 2023-05-31 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to [him]" — and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished him a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].

- Learned a lot and got great advice from professionals in the music industry; found it inspiring [S3T5].
- A producer advised him to stay true to himself and sound unique; it made him think about where he wants his music to go and is motivating him [S3T7].
- On 2023-05-16, still in Tokyo: shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline taken "last night" (2023-05-15) — "the skyline was stunning"; Dave praised the shot and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T13][S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]. Calvin thanked Dave and said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing, encouraging Dave to visit — "it's awesome!" [S6T17].
- As of 2023-05-16, he has an upcoming performance in Tokyo "this month" (May 2023) he is "super excited" for — great to show his music to a whole new crowd and hopefully expand his following [S6T11].
- As of 2023-05-31, he had been touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28) and called it "wild"; the Tokyo show was "unreal" — the crowd was "insane" — and performing "felt so alive" he "can't find the words to express it"; the energy and love from the fans was "crazy" [S7T1][S7T3]. This was the Frank Ocean tour his planned Boston trip was to follow (see the Boston trip section below); as of 2023-05-31, Boston is a stop on this tour itself.

- Plans for the trip: explore the city, try different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area [S1T13].
- Will be in Japan for a few months, then off to Boston afterward [S1T15].
- Plans to visit the park with the lake that Dave recommended, since he has never been there [S1T17].
- On 2023-05-03, said embracing nature has been really calming for him, and that he's been loving getting to know Japanese culture [S5T10].
- As of 2023-06-21, has a small town in Japan on his to-do list to visit after his tour with Frank Ocean ends — he has never been there. Shared a photo of a small-town view with a mountain in the background, saying the view of the mountains is "unbelievably stunning"; can't wait to see it in person [S9T11][S9T13][S9T14][S9T15].

- Later in the 2023-05-03 conversation: agreed with Calvin that driving with the wind in your hair, and walking around to explore the sights and sounds of nature, are calming [S5T9]; when Calvin said his music is stuck ("creativity's frozen"), gave him the creative-block tip (see ## Music) and encouraged Calvin to keep pursuing his music and never give up [S5T10][S5T11][S5T13]; the two said goodbye and agreed to keep in touch, with Dave saying Calvin can let him know if he ever needs help [S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no chat"); when Calvin shared that his place had flooded, Dave expressed sympathy, said the saved music gear and mic were "the important things", told Calvin to stay positive, and offered to help [S6T3][S6T4]; Dave praised Calvin's home music studio photo — "That studio looks awesome" — and said he hopes Calvin gets it fixed soon so he can keep creating [S6T5][S6T6]; when Calvin asked what he's working on, Dave excitedly told him about the shop's opening celebration (details in ## Car maintenance shop), and Calvin said he can't wait to get back to making music [S6T7][S6T8].
- The 2023-05-16 exchange continued: Calvin congratulated Dave on the shop (see ## Car maintenance shop), and when Dave asked about Calvin's music, Calvin shared the upcoming Tokyo performance [S6T10][S6T11]; Dave said doing a show in Tokyo is "wow", was sure the audience would love it, and wished him luck — Calvin promised to keep him posted on how it goes [S6T12][S6T13]; when Calvin shared a photo of the Tokyo night skyline (taken 2023-05-15), Dave called it a great shot, said the night skyline "really pops with those city lights," and said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon [S6T14][S6T15][S6T16]; after Calvin said the city lights in Tokyo are amazing and encouraged him to visit, Dave said he is "definitely adding it to [his] list" and thanked Calvin [S6T17][S6T18].
- The 2023-06-09 conversation continued: Calvin asked what was new and exciting for Dave, and Dave announced he booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023) — "finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks" (details in ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T10]. Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to escape it all and de-stress — see /memories/calvin.md > ## Mountains and hiking [S8T9]. The two exchanged trip wishes and signed off "see you soon" [S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, Calvin told Dave about a car accident he had on 2023-06-16 (no one hurt); Dave expressed sympathy, asked whether the insurance process had any issues and how long it took to sort out, and asked about the mechanic in Calvin's garage photo. Details of the accident and repair are in /memories/calvin.md > ## Car accident (2023-06-16) [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- Plans to make a trip to Boston after he finishes the Frank Ocean tour; has heard the music scene there is awesome and is excited to check it out [S3T9].
- Not yet seen Boston apart from gigs — he has been busy with rehearsals and traveling [S3T14][S3T15].
- Looking forward to exploring the city, trying out delicious food, and visiting popular attractions [S3T15].
- Dave (apparently Boston-based) is offering to show him around — including Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park — and to take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together when he is in Boston, and Dave agreed [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16] (see /memories/dave.md > ## Boston).
- Calvin is looking forward to trying the food in Boston with Dave and called it fun ("Can't wait to try out the food there with you") [S3T17].
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].

- As of 2023-07-07, has never been to Japan but is "so keen to go one day"; he's heard it's "full of vibes, good eats and awesome tech", and thinks experiencing the culture would be amazing — he's "hooked on" Japanese music [S10T11].
- Builds on his earlier interest: after seeing Calvin's Tokyo night-skyline photo (2023-05-16), he said he has to take a trip to Tokyo soon and is "definitely adding it to [his] list" (noted under ## Relationships) [S6T16][S6T18].
- On 2023-10-19, shown Calvin's photo of a concert crowd in Tokyo (hands in the air), reacted with "Wow, Calvin, that's an awesome pic! Everyone looks so pumped. Where was that taken?"; Calvin confirmed it was taken in Tokyo during a concert ("the energy was nuts - felt like the whole city came out!"); Dave then shared a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping (found online) — "Tokyo looks incredible! Here's a pic I found online, and it's making me dream about visiting someday. The energy there seems unbeatable!" — and asked whether Calvin had ever visited streets like that; Calvin: yes, visiting similar streets "was an incredible experience." When Calvin asked what else interests him in Tokyo, Dave said he wants to know "everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life!" (shared a photo of a crowded street at night — "the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive! It will be an unforgettable experience!"), and said "It's really amazing. Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!" (Calvin: "Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!") — a concrete update on his long-standing dream of visiting Tokyo, see above [S24T10][S24T11][S24T12][S24T13][S24T14][S24T15][S24T16].
- On 2023-10-19, shared a photo of a bowl of ramen he tried in Boston (a bowl of soup with broccoli and noodles) — "it was delicious, but in Tokyo it will be even better!" — encouraging Calvin (who has never tried it) to "give it a shot" in Tokyo — "Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!" (Calvin's November 2023 Tokyo trip, see /memories/calvin.md > ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)) [S24T20][S24T22].

- For Calvin's upcoming visit, mentioned the awesome music scene and named Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park; said he'll count himself in for the front row when Calvin is up onstage [S3T10].
- Shared a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water (Calvin's reply indicates it's Boston); Calvin said Boston looks great and thanked him for the tips [S3T10][S3T11].
- Plans to take Calvin to his favorite spots in the city for food; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together, and Dave agreed enthusiastically [S3T15][S3T16].
- Closed the 2023-04-20 conversation looking forward to showing Calvin "the amazing music and food" in Boston, saying "See you soon!" [S3T18].
- Also plans to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston (see ## Classic cars) [S3T12].
